subject: Structure of shiny based R packages

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Structure of shiny based R packages
parts:
Hi

I would like input to best practices when developing packages containing shiny apps. My main concern is the placement of helper function defined outside the shinyServer() call. Optimally I would like to place all functions within the R directory in the package structure and only have a library(myPackage) call ahead of the shinyServer() call. This is not a problem if all functions are exported, but being helper functions I would rather not have them pollute the users namespace.

Is the only way to have this setup to put myPackage::: in front of all function calls in shinyServer()?

best Thomas

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Structure of shiny based R packages
parts:
I'd say yes, ::: is the only way by definition.

Regards,
Yihui
